description:
We are engineers. Selma, Rand, Mariam, and Batoul, interested in ML and app development 

We're building Nominal (Python/Streamlit), a mobile-friendly game where players design satellites to solve Omani environmental challenges (floods, agriculture, dust) by balancing budget, power, and orbit to match real NASA missions.

Why Join Us? Clear 48-hour scope, high local impact, and a strong demo.Seeking: Python/UI designers, Earth science enthusiasts, and Arabic speakers for Omani school outreach.
